games.name: Mine Sweeper
games.description: The collection's first title. Clear the board without setting off a mine — four difficulties, four themes, best times per setting.

games.name: Dottie
games.tagline: Outrun the ghosts, clear the maze.
games.description: The collection's maze-chase. Guide Dottie through the corridors, sweep every pellet, and turn the tables on the four ghosts — four themes, one arcade heart.

games.name: Tilly
games.tagline: Slide the tiles, grow the numbers.
games.description: The collection's sliding-merge puzzle. Every move slides the whole board; matching tiles merge and double. Chase the biggest tile you can build.

games.name: Suki
games.description: The collection's sudoku. Clean grids, honest difficulty, notes when you want them — a puzzle that stays out of its own way.

games.name: Woozy
games.description: The collection's balance game, now in development. Keep Woozy upright as the floor stops cooperating. Staged ahead of its first release.
